event.description:
Grand Archive Weekly

Every Tuesday, the Archive calls to its champions. Gather your material deck, attune to your element, and face new rivals at The Trading Post.

The Archive keeps nothing for itself. Every entry fee goes back into the prize pool as store credit, and every champion who finishes with 2 wins or better gets a share.

Format: Standard
When: Every Tuesday at 6:30 PM
Entry: $10
